decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program needs little dedicated investment and supports the express positioning the firm has publicly committed to, but it overlaps with the broader express line D and remains a candidate for consolidation.
The European-approved exterior door was launched visibly at BAU as an extension of the core Teckentrup 62 system, so sunk certification costs and public commitment strongly favor persisting.
The multi-model express line has its own web page and anchors the firm's fast-delivery promise, which makes it a central and visible commitment the firm will justify keeping.
The fire and smoke protection door belongs to the certified core safety portfolio, and its approval investment and strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely.
